ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_RECORD_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dup_record_check IS
 counter NUMBER;
 chk NUMBER;
BEGIN
 if :global.item_code != :valid_item_master.item_code then
 /* new check */
 check_insert_rg('CRG_VALID_ITEM', 'C10', :global.item_code || ',', 'D', chk); 
 end if;

 IF :global.item_code = :valid_item_master.item_code THEN
 null;
 ELSE
 if :valid_item_master.item_code is not null then
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO counter
 FROM valid_item_master
 WHERE item_code = :valid_item_master.item_code
 and chapter_id =:global.chapter_id;
 if :system.record_status = 'INSERT' then 
 if counter > 0 then 
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 else 
 check_insert_rg( 'CRG_VALID_ITEM', 'C10', :valid_item_master.item_code || ',' , 'U', chk);
 IF chk >= 1 THEN
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 END IF;
 end if;
 end if;

 if :system.record_status = 'CHANGED' then
 if counter > 1 then
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 else
 check_insert_rg( 'CRG_VALID_ITEM', 'C10', :valid_item_master.item_code || ',', 'U', chk);
 IF chk >= 1 THEN
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 END IF;
 end if;
 end if; /* record status check end*/
 end if; /* not null if */
 END IF; /* 1st if then */
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_EFF_TERM_DATE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_eff_term_date (eff_date IN date, term_date IN date) IS
BEGIN
 if eff_date is not null then
 if term_date is not null then
 if term_date < trunc(sysdate) then
 show_error('3115'); --term date can not be less than sysdate
 end if;
 if eff_date > term_date then
 show_error('2314'); -- term date can not be less than eff date
 end if;
 end if;
 if eff_date < trunc(sysdate) then
 show_error('2312');
 end if;
 end if; 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_EFF_TERM_DATES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE validate_eff_term_dates( 
 eff_date IN date,
 term_date IN date,
 from_where IN varchar2) 
IS
 dt_chk boolean;
 v_local_time DATE;
begin
 
 -- Converts GMT date to local date (IM# 5320)
 if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, v_local_time);
 else
 v_local_time := sysdate;
 end if;
 --
 
 if eff_date is null then
 show_error('5002');
 end if;
 --if eff_date < trunc(sysdate) and from_where = 'E' then
 if eff_date < trunc(v_local_time) and from_where = 'E' then
 show_error('5015');
 end if;

 if term_date is not null then
 --if term_date < trunc(sysdate) then
 if term_date < trunc(v_local_time) then
 show_error('3115');
 end if;
 dt_chk := check_from_to_date( eff_date, term_date);
 if dt_chk then
 null;
 else
 --message('Err. Term date is before effective date.');
 --raise form_trigger_failure;
 show_error('5004');
 end if;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: SET_CONTROL_BLOCK_ITEMS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE set_control_block_items(action IN varchar2) IS
 sState varchar2(10);
BEGIN
 if action = 'E' then -- If to be enabled
 sState := 'FALSE'; -- Check if disabled
 else -- If to be disabled
 sState := 'TRUE'; -- Check if enabled
 end if;
 if get_item_property( 'ctrl_block.cb_show_term', enabled) = sState then
 item_change('ctrl_block.cb_show_term',action);
 end if;
 if get_item_property( 'ctrl_block.item_code', enabled) = sState then
 item_change('ctrl_block.item_code',action);
 end if;
 if get_item_property( 'ctrl_block.pb_item_code', enabled) = sState then
-- item_change('ctrl_block.pb_item_code',action);
 if action = 'E' then
 set_item_property( 'ctrl_block.pb_item_code', enabled, property_true );
 else
 set_item_property( 'ctrl_block.pb_item_code', enabled, property_false );
 end if;
 end if;
 if get_item_property( 'ctrl_block.pb_retrieve', enabled) = sState then
 item_change('ctrl_block.pb_retrieve',action);
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: RETRIEVE_DATA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE retrieve_data IS
 sWhere varchar2(200);
begin
 sWhere := 'item_code = nvl( :ctrl_block.item_code, item_code) and chapter_id= :global.chapter_id';
 if :ctrl_block.cb_show_term = 'N' then 
 sWhere := sWhere || ' and sysdate < nvl( term_date, sysdate + 1 ) and chapter_id= :global.chapter_id';
 end if;
 set_block_property( 'valid_item_master', DEFAULT_WHERE, sWhere);
 go_block( 'valid_item_master' );
 execute_query;
end;
